# defer Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

## Tech Design

- [Tech Design](../../projects/defer/tech-design): implementation source of truth.
- Validate: `aw td check projects/defer/tech-design`.

## Capability Map

- [README](README.md): capability source of truth and product contract.

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project defer`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project defer`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project defer blockers`.

## Commands

- Test: `true` until the Defer crate and service test gates exist.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): agent orientation for the app source root.
